questions.prompt: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?

source.note: Iron oxide dust gives Mars its red colour. Check: NASA Science, 'Mars facts'.
Sound moves at about 343 m/s in air; light at about 300,000 km/s. Check: any school physics text.

questions.prompt: What is the chemical symbol for gold?

source.note: Au, from the Latin aurum. Ag is silver, Gd gadolinium, Pt platinum. Check: IUPAC periodic table.

questions.prompt: Which gas makes up most of the Earth's atmosphere?

source.note: Dry air is about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen. Check: NASA Earth fact sheet.

questions.prompt: Which element has the atomic number 26?

source.note: Iron is 26; cobalt 27, copper 29, zinc 30. Check: IUPAC periodic table.

questions.prompt: Venus takes longer to spin once on its axis than to orbit the Sun.

source.note: Venus rotates once in about 243 Earth days and orbits the Sun in about 225. Check: NASA Venus fact sheet.
